text_en: I do not want you to be unaware, brothers and sisters, that our ancestors were all under the cloud, and all passed through the sea,
text_cn: 弟兄们，我愿意提醒你们，我们的祖先都曾在云柱下，都从海中走过，

text_en: and all were baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea,
text_cn: 都曾在云中和海中受了洗而归于梅瑟，

text_en: and all ate the same spiritual food,
text_cn: 都吃过同样的神粮，

text_en: and all drank the same spiritual drink. For they drank from the spiritual rock that followed them, and the rock was Christ.
text_cn: 都饮过同样的神饮；原来他们所饮的，是来自伴随他们的神磐石：那磐石就是基督。

text_en: Nevertheless, God was not pleased with most of them, and they were struck down in the wilderness.
text_cn: 可是，他们中多数不是天主所喜悦的，因而倒毙在旷野里了。

text_en: Now these things occurred as examples for us, so that we might not desire evil as they did.
text_cn: 这些事都是我们的鉴戒，为叫我们不贪恋恶事，就如他们贪恋过一样。

text_en: Do not become idolaters as some of them did; as it is written, “The people sat down to eat and drink, and they rose up to play. ”
text_cn: 你们也不可崇拜邪神，就如他们中有些人敬拜过一样，如同经上记载说：‘百姓坐下吃喝，起来玩乐。’

text_en: We must not indulge in sexual immorality as some of them did, and twenty-three thousand fell in a single day.
text_cn: 我们也不可淫乱，就如他们中有些人淫乱过，一天内就倒毙了二万三千人。

text_en: We must not put Christ to the test, as some of them did, and were destroyed by serpents.
text_cn: 我们也不可试探主，就如他们中有些人试探过，为蛇所歼灭。

text_en: And do not complain as some of them did, and were destroyed by the destroyer.
text_cn: 你们也不可抱怨，就如他们中有些人抱怨过，为毁灭者所消灭。

text_en: These things happened to them to serve as an example, and they were written down to instruct us, on whom the ends of the ages have come.
text_cn: 发生在他们身上的这一切事，都是为给人作鉴戒，并记录了下来，为劝戒我们这些生活在世末的人。

text_en: So if you think you are standing, watch out that you do not fall.
text_cn: 所以，凡自以为站得稳的，务要小心，免得跌倒。

text_en: No testing has overtaken you that is not common to everyone. God is faithful, and he will not let you be tested beyond your strength, but with the testing he will also provide the way out so that you may be able to endure it.
text_cn: 你们所受的试探，无非是普通人所能受的试探；天主是忠信的，他决不许你们受那超过你们能力的试探，天主如加给人试探，也必开一条出路，叫你们能够承担。

text_en: Therefore, my dear friends, flee from the worship of idols.
text_cn: 为此，我亲爱的诸位，你们要逃避崇拜邪神的事。

text_en: I speak as to sensible people; judge for yourselves what I say.
text_cn: 我想我是对明白人说话；你们自己审断我所说的吧！

text_en: The cup of blessing that we bless, is it not a sharing in the blood of Christ? The bread that we break, is it not a sharing in the body of Christ?
text_cn: 我们所祝福的那祝福之杯，岂不是共结合于基督的血吗？我们所擘开的饼，岂不是共结合于基督的身体吗？

text_en: Because there is one bread, we who are many are one body, for we all partake of the one bread.
text_cn: 因为饼只是一个，我们虽多，只是一个身体，因为我们众人都共享这一个饼。

text_en: Consider the people of Israel; are not those who eat the sacrifices partners in the altar?
text_cn: 你们且看按血统做以色列的，那些吃祭物的，不是与祭坛有分子的人吗？

text_en: What do I imply then? That food sacrificed to idols is anything, or that an idol is anything?
text_cn: 那么，我说什么呢？是说祭邪神的肉算得什么吗？或是说邪神算得什么吗？

text_en: No, I imply that what pagans sacrifice, they sacrifice to demons and not to God. I do not want you to be partners with demons.
text_cn: 不是，我说的是：外教人所祭祀的，是祭祀邪魔，而不是祭祀真神。我不愿意你们与邪魔有分子。

text_en: You cannot drink the cup of the Lord and the cup of demons. You cannot partake of the table of the Lord and the table of demons.
text_cn: 你们不能喝主的杯，又喝邪魔的杯；你们不能共享主的筵席，又共享邪魔的筵席。

text_en: Or are we provoking the Lord to jealousy? Are we stronger than he?
text_cn: 难道我们要惹主发怒吗？莫非我们比他还强吗？

text_en: “All things are lawful, ” but not all things are beneficial. “All things are lawful, ” but not all things build up.
text_cn: “凡事都可行，”但不全有益；“凡事都可行，”但不全助人建树。

text_en: Do not seek your own advantage, but that of the other.
text_cn: 人不要只求自己的利益，但也该求别人的利益。

text_en: Eat whatever is sold in the meat market without raising any question on the ground of conscience,
text_cn: 凡在肉市上买来的，为了良心的原故，不必查问什么，你们只管吃吧！

text_en: for “the earth and its fullness are the Lord’s. ”
text_cn: ‘因为大地和其中的万物，属于上主。’

text_en: If an unbeliever invites you to a meal and you are disposed to go, eat whatever is set before you without raising any question on the ground of conscience.
text_cn: 若有一个无信仰的人宴请你们，你们也愿意去，凡给你们摆上的，为了良心的原故，不必查问什么，你们只管吃吧！

text_en: But if someone says to you, “This has been offered in sacrifice, ” then do not eat it, out of consideration for the one who informed you, and for the sake of conscience—
text_cn: 但若有人向你们说：“这是祭过神的肉，”为了那指点的人，和为了良心的原故，你们就不可吃。

text_en: I mean the other’s conscience, not your own. For why should my liberty be subject to the judgment of someone else’s conscience?
text_cn: 我说的良心不是自己的，而是他人的良心。那么，我的自由为什么要受他人良心的束缚呢？

text_en: If I partake with thankfulness, why should I be denounced because of that for which I give thanks?
text_cn: 我若以谢恩之心参加，为什么我要因谢恩之物而受人责骂呢？

text_en: So, whether you eat or drink, or whatever you do, do everything for the glory of God.
text_cn: 所以，你们或吃或喝，或无论作什么，一切都要为光荣天主而作。

text_en: Give no offense to Jews or to Greeks or to the church of God,
text_cn: 你们不可成为犹太人，或希腊人，或天主的教会跌倒的原因，

text_en: just as I try to please everyone in everything I do, not seeking my own advantage, but that of many, so that they may be saved.
text_cn: 但要如我一样，在一切事上使众人喜欢，不求我自己的利益，只求大众的利益，为使他们得救。
